items.title: Recognizing Market Needs and Customer Demands

source_refs.note: Unnumbered topic Recognizing Market Needs and Customer Demands under 9.4 as printed (PDF 132, printed 128).

blocks.text: Recognizing market needs and customer demands means understanding what people want and what problems they face. Entrepreneurs study customer behavior, preferences, and trends to design better products and services. Surveys, feedback, and online data help identify gaps in the market. Meeting customer needs effectively leads to customer satisfaction and business success. In the digital economy, analyzing online trends and user feedback is very important for creating successful business ideas.
